chapter: Learning the drums and first job
title: First job with trumpeter Euless Jean
summary: His first job was with Euless Jean, who inspired him to play drums; Jean now lives in Baton Rouge.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Can you tell me about the first job you ever played now? Yeah, the first job I played was with Euless Jean.
He was a trumpet player, a good friend of mine. Yes, I heard him play one time. Yeah, he's the cause I start playing drums, because he played the trumpet and I said, well, I'll play the drums.
Do you know anything about him? I'm not sure if he's still living. Somebody said...
Yeah, he's living. He's living. Him and I worked together over the river on a project. He's blaspheming, you know.
How long have you, since you've seen him?
It was, uh, no, it must be about four months since I said...

Well, that late then. Yeah. Because somebody told me that once he went up like Baton Rouge or someplace... Yeah, he's living in Baton Rouge, but he come here to work. But he comes here to work. Well, I didn't know.

Yeah. I saw him about 1944. It's the only time I ever saw him and heard him play. You did, eh? Uh-huh. That's been, oh, years ago now. Oh, yeah. Twenty-one years ago. Yeah. Let's see if there's anything else about your drum set while I can think of it. Uh-huh. Did you use that tom-toms?
